content.text: MOA: Compete w Cl in Na/K/2Cl cotransport ->⍉ reabsorb
↓ preload (↓ vol) & ↓ afterload (NO -dilator) b/c most Na reabsorb
Clin Use: ↑efficacy diuretic & remove Na/Cl from body->↑↑↑ urine
Administration: can be based on pt daily wt
Ototoxicity:↑w aminoglycoside, ↑dose, rapid IV admin, ethacrynic acid
Acute hypovolemia: rapid ↓ vol -> hypotension, shock, arrhythmia
Also AE: dizziness, rash, ↑cholesterol, anorexia, urinary bladder spasm, blurred vision
Efficacy- improve S/Sx edema and/or BP
•block sodium/Cl reabsorb in the thick ascending loop of Henle by interfering w/ the chloride-binding co-transport system
•increases excretion of Na, K, Cl, Mg, Ca, & H2O
: ⍉mortality benefit in HF pts; used to relieve sxs related to congestion/edema
: ↓ Na, K, Cl, Mg, Ca, hyperuricemia, ↑BG, ↑TG/total cholest, orthostatic hypotension, photosensitivity, ↑urination
admin: IM; SQ; nasal spray (only 1 nostril, alt nostrils each day)
SE: inj site rxn       -    rhinitis    -   nasal congest
take in AM on empty stomach
SE: esophageal erosion     -    GI distress: diarrhea

: potent inhibitors of bone resorption; bind to hydroxyapatite crystals in bone & antagonize osteoclast activity; osteoclast activate, form, & recruitment are inhibited, & life span = ↓; increase osteoblast prolif & intestinal calcium absorb
: esophagitis, MSK sxs, hypocalcemia, GI (oral) – abd pain, dyspepsia, N/V, dysphagia, heartburn
: osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ), atypical femur fractures – limit tx to 3-5yrs in pts w/ ↓risk of frx
: caution in pts w/ aspirin-sensitive asthma – can induce bronchoconstrict

: functionally antagonizes the effects of PTH; directly inhibits osteoclastic bone resorption; promotes the renal excretion of calcium, phosphate, sodium, magnesium, and potassium by decreasing tubular reabsorb; increases the jejunal secretion of H2O, sodium, potassium, and Cl
: back pain, myalgia, nausea, dizziness, inj (flushing & inj site rxns)
: hypocalcemia (assoc w/ tetany/seizures), ↑risk of malig w/ long-term use, hypersensitivity to salmon-derived prod, Ab form, nasal spray (nasal ulcerations, epistaxis, rhinitis)
